projects.title: Custom CAD Viewer & Editor, built from zero
projects.summary: Took a CAD viewer from an uncertain R&D stage to a production custom editor: DXF rendering engine, spatial indexing, full editing suite, DXF/PDF export. Became the foundation of a core product workflow.
projects.role: Frontend engineer → primary owner of the CAD viewer/editor; led UI technical direction for the first ~2 months

projects.title: Railway Signalling-Plan Digitisation & Editing
projects.summary: Digitise scheme drawings into structured JSON plans; render and edit domain assets (signals, track circuits, aspect control charts) directly on the CAD canvas; red/green change detection between versions.

projects.title: Website & Knowledge-Base Ingestion
projects.summary: Modules to ingest websites and files into a knowledge base: URL/file and bulk upload, URL restrictions, permission-based access, PDF/HTML rendering, bounding-box visualization, accessibility-tree tooling.

projects.title: Bounding-Box Visualization for Captured Web Pages
projects.summary: Overlay extracted element bounding boxes on downloaded HTML pages, so extraction results can be verified visually; built with the backend team.

projects.title: Document Review Viewer: Precise Highlighting
projects.summary: PDF rendering with accurate text and image highlighting, bounding-box visualization and improved pagination for reviewing long documents.

projects.title: Progressive PDF Viewer
projects.summary: Opens large PDFs fast by streaming pages with HTTP Range Requests; virtualized rendering.

projects.title: Real-time API & SSE Integrations
projects.summary: REST integrations and live progress via Server-Sent Events for long-running processing jobs.

projects.title: Enterprise Angular UI Architecture
projects.summary: Reusable components, modular features, reactive forms, PrimeNG data tables, performance on large JSON.

projects.title: Portfolio RAG Agent (this site)
projects.summary: AI agent answering questions about me with citations that light up the knowledge graph; SSE streaming.

projects.title: Jarvis Voice Mode
